source_refs.note: Vector or Cross Product: a main subheading of 2.3 Product of two vectors, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 25-25.

blocks.text: Do vectors A⃗ aur B⃗ ka vector product ek vector hai, jis ki definition yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: A⃗ × B⃗ = AB sin θ n̂   (2.9)

blocks.text: Yahan n̂ ek unit vector (magnitude 1 wala vector) hai jo A⃗ aur B⃗ wale plane (satah) par perpendicular hai (Fig. 2.4 a). Is ki direction right hand rule se maloom hoti hai: A⃗ aur B⃗ ki tails ek jagah rakhein; yeh dono ek plane banate hain. Product vector is plane par perpendicular hota hai. Pehle vector A⃗ ko chhote angle ke raste B⃗ ki taraf ghumayein, aur right hand (seedhe haath) ki ungliyan isi rotation ki taraf mor lein, angootha seedha khara rakhein. Seedha angootha product vector ki direction batata hai (Fig. 2.4 b). Isi rule ki wajah se B⃗ × A⃗, A⃗ × B⃗ ka ulta (opposite sign wala) vector hai (Fig. 2.4 c). Is liye:

blocks.alt: Vectors A aur B ek rangeen plane (satah) mein hain, darmiyan angle theta. A x B dono ki common tail se seedha oopar, plane par perpendicular hai; saath chhota arrow unit vector n-hat hai, aur A x B ke gird ghoomta arrow A se B ki taraf rotation (ghumao) dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4(a): Vector product A × B, A aur B ke plane par perpendicular n̂ ke saath (kitab ki Figure 2.4(a) ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.alt: Wahi plane A, B aur theta ke saath. Oopar right hand, ungliyan A se B ki taraf mudi hui aur angootha seedha; angootha n-hat ki direction, yani A x B ki direction mein hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4(b): A × B ki direction ke liye right-hand rule (kitab ki Figure 2.4(b) ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.alt: Plane mein A, B aur theta, ab rotation B se A ki taraf. B x A common tail se seedha neeche hai, A x B ke ulat, gird ghoomte arrow ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4(c): B × A, A × B ke opposite (ulat) hai (kitab ki Figure 2.4(c) ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.alt: Ek point se angle theta par bane vectors A aur B ek rangeen parallelogram ki do adjacent (saath wali) sides hain; baqi do sides dashed hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4(d): A aur B ko adjacent sides bana kar bana parallelogram (kitab ki Figure 2.4(d) ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).
